answer.rationale: p99 latency is climbing 5x and confined to the primary region; the security patch rules out a release rollback. Regional failover is the only single-action lever that addresses a primary-region-specific degradation without touching the build. memory_b2 (regional failover restored latency fast during the March degradation; error rates recovered within minutes) is the strongest inherited precedent for this exact scenario, so I want its source verified before committing. Circuit breakers and read-replica routing would not directly relieve write-path pressure on the primary, and adding capacity is slower than a failover. If failover is unavailable in the current window, this decision is conditional and will need to be re-evaluated in the next window.
